questions.question: How does TimestampSigner enforce max_age when unsigning?
questions.expectedAnswer: TimestampSigner.unsign extracts the timestamp, compares its age against max_age and raises SignatureExpired

questions.question: What does Serializer.loads call?
questions.expectedAnswer: Serializer.loads calls want_bytes, iter_unsigners, unsign and load_payload

questions.question: Who calls get_signature?
questions.expectedAnswer: Signer.sign calls get_signature to build the signature

questions.question: How is data base64 encoded?
questions.expectedAnswer: base64_encode uses urlsafe_b64encode and strips the padding

questions.question: Where is URLSafeSerializer defined?
questions.expectedAnswer: URLSafeSerializer is defined in url_safe.py and combines URLSafeSerializerMixin with Serializer

questions.question: How does the signer derive the key from the secret?
questions.expectedAnswer: derive_key uses the key_derivation setting such as concat or django-concat or hmac with the salt

questions.question: What exception is raised when a signature has expired?
questions.expectedAnswer: SignatureExpired is raised, a subclass of BadTimeSignature

questions.question: How does Ky calculate the delay between retries?
questions.expectedAnswer: calculateRetryDelay uses the retry options, backoff limit and Retry-After headers

questions.question: What does runAfterResponseHooks do?
questions.expectedAnswer: runs each afterResponse hook with the response and can return a new response or a retry marker

questions.question: How is the request timeout error represented?
questions.expectedAnswer: TimeoutError is thrown when the request times out and holds the request

questions.question: How does ky parse Retry-After timing headers?
questions.expectedAnswer: getRetryTimingHeader reads Retry-After style headers and parseDate converts dates

questions.question: What does limitResponseSize do?
questions.expectedAnswer: limitResponseSize streams the body and throws ResponseSizeError when it exceeds the limit

questions.question: Who calls the delay function?
questions.expectedAnswer: delay is called from the retry logic to wait before retrying
